A '''battle''' between [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] forces at the world of [[Emmer]] took place in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. After the fledgling [[Alliance of Free Planets]]/[[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] repelled the [[Nagai–Tof War|Nagai]] and [[Ssi-ruuvi invasions]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] led Republic forces that had been kept pent in by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] began a campaign in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] against the Empire. Emmer was an Imperial fortress world. Nevertheless, the New Republic were able to defeat the Empire there. As a result, another nearby fortress world, [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]], became isolated from other Imperial-allied [[Star system/Legends|systems]].<ref name="TEA" />
